translations.web: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
translations.bsb: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
translations.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
translations.asv: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
